en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no compensation (to be paid) by relative with regards to the mischief, nor retaliation, and the mischievous terrifying, occurring by the night and the day, so the man is scarred during it, or falls being killed, not known who killed him and scarred him’.
And Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said, in another Hadeeth, raising it to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>: ‘So it would be paid from the public treasury’.
